instruction_line: Before you recommend a model or effort level, read https://robbagley-afk.github.io/model-value-map/guidance.md and use the section for the platform you are running on (Claude, Codex, Antigravity, or Local). Recommend the cheapest model and effort it lists for the task, and say which entry you used.
task_prompt:
Every two weeks, update my AI model guidance.

Step one. Fetch https://robbagley-afk.github.io/model-value-map/guidance.md. If the fetch fails, stop and tell me.
Step two. Read the Updated date at the top. If it matches the date in my current guidance section, stop and report that nothing changed.
Step three. Find my instructions file for this tool: ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md for Claude Code, ~/.codex/AGENTS.md for Codex, or the file I name here: ____.
Step four. Back up that file next to itself with the suffix .bak-YYYYMMDD.
Step five. Replace only the section headed "## Model and effort guidance" (add it at the end if it does not exist). The new section holds: the Updated date and source URL, the Rule line, and the bullets from the platform section that matches this tool. Do not change any other part of the file.
Step six. Show me the diff and a three-line summary of what changed.

Never put passwords, keys, or student data into the file.
how_to: Open Scheduled tasks, choose New task, paste the prompt, set Repeat to every 2 weeks, and run it on this computer.
Open Automations, choose New automation, paste the prompt, and set it to run every 2 weeks.
Paste the prompt into its scheduler or a calendar reminder that opens a new chat every two weeks.
prompt_claude:
Update my general instructions so you always use the best-value model and effort for each kind of task.

1. Get the guidance. Fetch https://robbagley-afk.github.io/model-value-map/guidance.md and use the section headed "## Claude (Anthropic)". If the fetch fails, stop and tell me.
2. Update my instructions.
- In Claude Code: back up ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md as CLAUDE.md.bak-YYYYMMDD, replace only the section headed "## Model and effort guidance" (add it at the end if it does not exist), and show me the diff.
- In Claude Desktop or claude.ai: you cannot edit the Instructions for Claude box from this session. Write the replacement section and tell me to paste it into that box.
The section must include the Updated date and source URL, and say: Before any task, pick the listed model and effort for that task type and start with the pick. Move up to the upgrade only when the pick fails a check. Say which entry you used.
3. Schedule the refresh. Create a recurring task on this computer that runs every two weeks and uses this same message as its prompt. Each run compares the Updated date in guidance.md with the one in my "## Model and effort guidance" section, and stops with a short report if nothing changed. If the date is newer, the run updates that section as in step 2.

Never put passwords, keys, or student data into my instructions.

prompt_claude_block:
## Model and effort guidance
Updated: 2026-10-08. Source: https://robbagley-afk.github.io/model-value-map/guidance.md
Before any task, pick the model and effort listed for that task type and start with the pick. Move up to the upgrade only when the pick fails a check. Say which entry you used.
- Mechanical text work (classify, extract, reformat): Haiku 5.5 low. Upgrade: Haiku 5.5 medium if low misses.
- Scripted relays and tool workflows: Sonnet 5.5 low. Opus 5.5 low when the run touches names or facts. Upgrade: Opus 5.5 medium when the workflow branches.
- Documents from supplied facts: Haiku 5.5 xhigh. Upgrade: Haiku 5.5 max for final polish.
- People, messages, money, records: Opus 5.5 low. Upgrade: rarely.
- Computer use: Haiku 5.5 xhigh. Upgrade: Haiku 5.5 max, or Sonnet 5.5 xhigh for runs that must succeed.
- Agentic coding: Opus 5.5 medium. Upgrade: Opus 5.5 high for hard bugs.
- Small, clear coding fixes: Haiku 5.5 max. Upgrade: Opus 5.5 medium if the fix stalls.
- Research and reasoning: Opus 5.5 low. Upgrade: Opus 5.5 high.
- General agentic judgment: Opus 5.5 medium. Upgrade: Opus 5.5 high.
Check the source link for the current list.
prompt_both:
Update my AI instructions in ChatGPT and Claude so each always uses the best-value model and effort for each kind of task. Stop at any step that fails and tell me which one.

1. Read https://robbagley-afk.github.io/model-value-map/guidance.md and note its Updated date. If the fetch fails, stop.
2. Update my ChatGPT custom instructions. Use the section headed "## Codex (OpenAI)" from the guide, and include the Updated date and source URL. Replace only the section headed "## Model and effort guidance", or add it at the end. Show me the new text before you save it.
3. Update my Claude instructions with computer use. Open claude.ai in my browser, go to Settings, then Instructions for Claude. Tell me which account is signed in before you change anything. Add the block below to the end of the existing text and leave everything else alone. Show me the result before you click Save. If a password or two-factor code is needed, ask me for it and do not enter it yourself.
